source.text: וַיְהִ֣י׀בַּחֹ֣דֶשׁ הַשְּׁבִיעִ֗י בָּ֣א יִשְׁמָעֵ֣אל בֶּן־נְתַנְיָ֣ה בֶן־אֱלִישָׁמָ֣ע מִזֶּ֣רַע הַ֠מְּלוּכָה וְרַבֵּ֨י הַמֶּ֜לֶךְ וַעֲשָׂרָ֨ה אֲנָשִׁ֥ים אִתּ֛וֹ אֶל־גְּדַלְיָ֥הוּ בֶן־אֲחִיקָ֖ם הַמִּצְפָּ֑תָה וַיֹּ֨אכְלוּ שָׁ֥ם לֶ֛חֶם יַחְדָּ֖ו בַּמִּצְפָּֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: And it was in the month the seventh, came Ishmael son of Nethaniah son of Elishama, of [the] seed of the kingship, and [the] chiefs of the king, and ten men with him, to Gedaliah son of Ahikam [to] Mizpah, and they ate there bread together at Mizpah.

en.L: And it came about in the seventh month [that] Ishmael son of Nethaniah son of Elishama, of the royal seed and [one of] the chief officers of the king, came, and ten men with him, to Gedaliah son of Ahikam at Mizpah, and they ate bread there together at Mizpah.
en.B: In the seventh month Ishmael son of Nethaniah, son of Elishama, who was of royal descent and one of the king's chief officers, came to Gedaliah son of Ahikam at Mizpah, bringing ten men with him. There at Mizpah they ate a meal together.
en.R: In the seventh month, Ishmael son of Nethaniah and grandson of Elishama came to Gedaliah son of Ahikam at Mizpah with ten men. Ishmael belonged to the royal family and was one of the king's high officers. They all ate a meal together there at Mizpah.

es.L: Y sucedió en el mes séptimo [que] vino Ismael hijo de Netanías, hijo de Elisama, de la descendencia real y [uno de] los jefes del rey, y diez hombres con él, a Gedalías hijo de Ahicam, a Mizpa, y comieron allí pan juntos en Mizpa.
es.B: En el mes séptimo, Ismael hijo de Netanías, hijo de Elisama, que era de sangre real y uno de los altos oficiales del rey, vino a ver a Gedalías hijo de Ahicam en Mizpa, con diez hombres. Allí en Mizpa comieron juntos.
es.R: En el mes séptimo, Ismael hijo de Netanías y nieto de Elisama llegó con diez hombres a Mizpa, donde estaba Gedalías hijo de Ahicam. Ismael era de la familia real y uno de los altos oficiales del rey. Todos comieron juntos allí en Mizpa.

fr.L: Et il arriva au septième mois [qu’]Ismaël fils de Netania, fils d’Élishama, de la descendance royale et [l’un] des grands du roi, vint, et dix hommes avec lui, auprès de Guedalia fils d’Ahiqam, à Mitspa ; et ils mangèrent là du pain ensemble, à Mitspa.
fr.B: Au septième mois, Ismaël fils de Netania, fils d’Élishama, qui était de descendance royale et l’un des grands officiers du roi, vint auprès de Guedalia fils d’Ahiqam, à Mitspa, avec dix hommes. Là, à Mitspa, ils prirent un repas ensemble.
fr.R: Au septième mois, Ismaël fils de Netania et petit-fils d’Élishama est venu voir Guedalia fils d’Ahiqam à Mitspa avec dix hommes. Ismaël faisait partie de la famille royale et c’était l’un des hauts officiers du roi. Ils ont tous pris un repas ensemble là, à Mitspa.

sw.L: Ikawa katika mwezi wa saba, Ishmaeli mwana wa Nethania mwana wa Elishama, wa uzao wa kifalme na [mmoja wa] maafisa wakuu wa mfalme, akaja, na watu kumi pamoja naye, kwa Gedalia mwana wa Ahikamu huko Mizpa, nao wakala chakula huko pamoja huko Mizpa.
sw.B: Katika mwezi wa saba Ishmaeli mwana wa Nethania, mwana wa Elishama, aliyekuwa wa ukoo wa kifalme na mmoja wa maafisa wakuu wa mfalme, alikuja kwa Gedalia mwana wa Ahikamu huko Mizpa pamoja na watu kumi. Huko Mizpa wakala chakula pamoja.
sw.R: Katika mwezi wa saba, Ishmaeli mwana wa Nethania na mjukuu wa Elishama alikuja kwa Gedalia mwana wa Ahikamu huko Mizpa pamoja na watu kumi. Ishmaeli alikuwa mtu wa ukoo wa kifalme na mmoja wa maafisa wakuu wa mfalme. Wote wakala chakula pamoja huko Mizpa.

vi.L: Xảy ra vào tháng thứ bảy, Ích-ma-ên con trai Nê-tha-nia, con trai Ê-li-sa-ma, thuộc dòng dõi hoàng gia và [là một trong] các quan lớn của vua, cùng mười người đến với Ghê-đa-lia con trai A-hi-cam tại Mích-ba, và tại Mích-ba họ cùng nhau ăn bánh.
vi.B: Vào tháng bảy, Ích-ma-ên con trai Nê-tha-nia, cháu Ê-li-sa-ma, thuộc dòng dõi hoàng gia và là một trong các quan lớn của vua, dẫn mười người đến gặp Ghê-đa-lia con trai A-hi-cam tại Mích-ba. Tại Mích-ba họ cùng nhau dùng bữa.
vi.R: Vào tháng bảy, Ích-ma-ên con trai Nê-tha-nia và cháu nội Ê-li-sa-ma đến gặp Ghê-đa-lia con trai A-hi-cam tại Mích-ba, cùng với mười người. Ích-ma-ên thuộc hoàng tộc và là một trong các quan chức cao cấp của vua. Họ cùng nhau ăn một bữa tại Mích-ba.

ko.L: 그리고 일곱째 달에 왕족의 씨요 왕의 고관 [가운데 하나인] 엘리사마의 손자 느다냐의 아들 이스마엘이 열 사람과 함께 미스바로 아히감의 아들 그다랴에게 왔다. 그리고 그들이 거기 미스바에서 함께 빵을 먹었다.
ko.B: 일곱째 달에 왕족 출신이며 왕의 고관 가운데 하나인, 엘리사마의 손자요 느다냐의 아들인 이스마엘이 열 사람을 데리고 미스바로 아히감의 아들 그다랴를 찾아왔다. 그들은 거기 미스바에서 함께 식사를 했다.
ko.R: 일곱째 달에 느다냐의 아들이며 엘리사마의 손자인 이스마엘이 열 사람을 데리고 미스바로 아히감의 아들 그다랴를 찾아왔다. 이스마엘은 왕족이었고 왕의 높은 관리 가운데 하나였다. 그들은 모두 거기 미스바에서 함께 식사를 했다.

pt.L: E aconteceu, no sétimo mês, [que] Ismael, filho de Netanias, filho de Elisama, da descendência real e [um dos] principais oficiais do rei, veio, e dez homens com ele, a Gedalias, filho de Aicam, em Mispá; e comeram pão ali juntos, em Mispá.
pt.B: No sétimo mês, Ismael, filho de Netanias, filho de Elisama, que era de descendência real e um dos principais oficiais do rei, veio a Gedalias, filho de Aicam, em Mispá, trazendo dez homens com ele. E ali, em Mispá, eles fizeram uma refeição juntos.
pt.R: No sétimo mês, Ismael, filho de Netanias e neto de Elisama, foi a Mispá com dez homens para ver Gedalias, filho de Aicam. Ismael era da família real e um dos oficiais mais importantes do rei. Ali em Mispá, todos fizeram uma refeição juntos.

decisions.choice: told briefly in 2 Kings 25:25
decisions.reason: 2 Kings 25:25 tells the same murder in one verse. Jeremiah adds three things: that Ishmael was also one of the king's chief officers, the name of Gedaliah's father, and the meal they shared before the killing. Kings says only that Ishmael and his men came and struck Gedaliah down.

decisions.choice: the seventh month: autumn; no year is given
decisions.reason: As in 2 Kings 25:25, the year is not named. It is usually taken to be the same year that Jerusalem fell, about two months after the temple was burned (52:12-13), but it may have been a later year.

decisions.choice: and [one of] the chief officers of the king: a second description of Ishmael
alternatives: some of the king's chief officers came with him
decisions.reason: The words are loosely joined to what comes before. They can describe Ishmael himself, as a man of the royal line who also held high rank at court, or they can name a further group who came with him, some of the king's officers. 2 Kings 25:25 does not have the phrase, and the Greek translation is reported not to have it either, which suggests it may be a later addition to the Hebrew. The first reading fits the singular verb "came".

decisions.choice: they ate bread together: a shared meal, a bond of trust
decisions.reason: To eat at someone's table was to be his guest and under his protection. Killing a host after sharing his food was a deep betrayal (Psalm 41:10). Gedaliah had been warned that Ishmael meant to kill him and had refused to believe it (40:13-16).

decisions.choice: of the royal seed (Literal); of royal descent (Balanced); a member of the royal family (Readable); a meal (Balanced and Readable)
decisions.reason: Worded as in 2 Kings 25:25. "Bread" stands for food in general, so Balanced and Readable say "a meal". Readable gives Ishmael's rank in a sentence of its own.

decisions.choice: de la descendencia real (L); de sangre real (B); de la familia real (R)
decisions.reason: The wording of the parallel 2 Kings 25:25, with the added "chief officers of the king" that only Jeremiah has.

decisions.choice: the wording of 2 Kings 25:25 in Swahili ("wa uzao wa kifalme" L; "wa ukoo wa kifalme" B, R), reused where the Hebrew is the same
decisions.reason: Jeremiah 41:1-3 tells at length what 2 Kings 25:25 tells briefly; the published Swahili wording is kept for the shared words.

decisions.choice: the wording of 2 Kings 25:25 ("de la descendance royale", L; "de descendance royale", B; "faisait partie de la famille royale", R)
decisions.reason: The murder is told briefly in 2 Kings 25:25; the French reuses its published wording where the Hebrew is the same.

decisions.choice: thuộc dòng dõi hoàng gia (L, B); thuộc hoàng tộc (R)
decisions.reason: The wording of 2 Kings 25:25, which tells this briefly, is kept.

decisions.choice: "왕족의 씨" (L), "왕족 출신" (B), "왕족" (R), as published in 2 Kings 25:25
decisions.reason: The terms note's rule for parallels: the shared words keep the Korean of 2 Kings 25:25.

decisions.choice: "함께 빵을 먹었다" (L); "함께 식사를 했다" (B, R)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Hebrew "ate bread"; the meaning decision explains the shared meal as a bond of trust.

decisions.choice: da descendência real (L), de descendência real (B), da família real (R); Ismael, filho de Netanias; Joanã, filho de Careá; Mispá
decisions.reason: For the whole book: the story of Gedaliah's murder and the flight (40:7-43:7) keeps the names and the wording 2 Kings 25:22-26 gives it in Portuguese, which this chapter tells at length (m1): "Ismael, filho de Netanias", "Joanã, filho de Careá", "Mispá", the royal line as there at each level. "Comeram pão" stays at Literal; Balanced and Readable say "fizeram uma refeição", as the English says "a meal".

source.text: וַיָּקָם֩ יִשְׁמָעֵ֨אל בֶּן־נְתַנְיָ֜ה וַעֲשֶׂ֥רֶת הָאֲנָשִׁ֣ים׀אֲשֶׁר־הָי֣וּ אִתּ֗וֹ וַ֠יַּכּוּ אֶת־גְּדַלְיָ֨הוּ בֶן־אֲחִיקָ֧ם בֶּן־שָׁפָ֛ן בַּחֶ֖רֶב וַיָּ֣מֶת אֹת֑וֹ אֲשֶׁר־הִפְקִ֥יד מֶֽלֶךְ־בָּבֶ֖ל בָּאָֽרֶץ׃

records.literal_gloss: And arose Ishmael son of Nethaniah and the ten men who were with him, and they struck Gedaliah son of Ahikam son of Shaphan with the sword, and he put to death him whom had appointed [the] king of Babylon over the land.

en.L: And Ishmael son of Nethaniah and the ten men who were with him arose and struck Gedaliah son of Ahikam son of Shaphan with the sword, and he put to death him whom the king of Babylon had appointed over the land.
en.B: Then Ishmael son of Nethaniah and the ten men with him got up and struck down Gedaliah son of Ahikam, son of Shaphan, with the sword. So he killed the man whom the king of Babylon had appointed governor of the land.
en.R: Then Ishmael son of Nethaniah and the ten men with him got up and attacked Gedaliah son of Ahikam, the son of Shaphan, with their swords. So Ishmael killed the man the king of Babylon had put in charge of the land.

es.L: Y se levantó Ismael hijo de Netanías y los diez hombres que estaban con él, e hirieron a Gedalías hijo de Ahicam, hijo de Safán, a espada, y mató a aquel a quien el rey de Babilonia había puesto sobre la tierra.
es.B: Entonces Ismael hijo de Netanías y los diez hombres que estaban con él se levantaron e hirieron a espada a Gedalías hijo de Ahicam, hijo de Safán. Así mató al hombre que el rey de Babilonia había nombrado gobernador del país.
es.R: Entonces Ismael hijo de Netanías y los diez hombres que estaban con él se levantaron y atacaron con sus espadas a Gedalías hijo de Ahicam, hijo de Safán. Así Ismael mató al hombre que el rey de Babilonia había puesto a cargo del país.

fr.L: Et Ismaël fils de Netania et les dix hommes qui étaient avec lui se levèrent et frappèrent Guedalia fils d’Ahiqam, fils de Shaphân, avec l’épée, et il fit mourir celui que le roi de Babylone avait établi sur le pays.
fr.B: Alors Ismaël fils de Netania et les dix hommes qui l’accompagnaient se levèrent et abattirent par l’épée Guedalia fils d’Ahiqam, fils de Shaphân. Il tua ainsi l’homme que le roi de Babylone avait établi gouverneur du pays.
fr.R: Alors Ismaël fils de Netania et les dix hommes qui étaient avec lui se sont levés et ont attaqué Guedalia fils d’Ahiqam, fils de Shaphân, avec leurs épées. Ismaël a ainsi tué l’homme que le roi de Babylone avait mis à la tête du pays.

sw.L: Ndipo Ishmaeli mwana wa Nethania na wale watu kumi waliokuwa pamoja naye wakainuka, wakampiga Gedalia mwana wa Ahikamu mwana wa Shafani kwa upanga, naye akamwua yule ambaye mfalme wa Babeli alikuwa amemweka juu ya nchi.
sw.B: Kisha Ishmaeli mwana wa Nethania na wale watu kumi waliokuwa pamoja naye wakainuka, wakampiga Gedalia mwana wa Ahikamu, mwana wa Shafani, kwa upanga. Basi akamwua mtu ambaye mfalme wa Babeli alikuwa amemweka kuwa mtawala wa nchi.
sw.R: Kisha Ishmaeli mwana wa Nethania na wale watu kumi waliokuwa pamoja naye wakainuka, wakamshambulia Gedalia mwana wa Ahikamu, mwana wa Shafani, kwa panga zao. Basi Ishmaeli akamwua mtu ambaye mfalme wa Babeli alikuwa amemweka kuwa msimamizi wa nchi.

vi.L: Ích-ma-ên con trai Nê-tha-nia và mười người ở với hắn đứng dậy, dùng gươm đánh Ghê-đa-lia con trai A-hi-cam, con trai Sa-phan, và hắn giết người mà vua Ba-by-lôn đã lập cai quản xứ.
vi.B: Bấy giờ Ích-ma-ên con trai Nê-tha-nia và mười người đi theo hắn đứng dậy, dùng gươm đâm Ghê-đa-lia con trai A-hi-cam, cháu Sa-phan. Vậy hắn giết người mà vua Ba-by-lôn đã lập làm tổng đốc cai quản xứ.
vi.R: Bấy giờ Ích-ma-ên con trai Nê-tha-nia và mười người đi theo hắn đứng dậy, dùng gươm tấn công Ghê-đa-lia con trai A-hi-cam, cháu Sa-phan. Vậy Ích-ma-ên giết người mà vua Ba-by-lôn đã giao cho cai quản xứ.

ko.L: 그리고 느다냐의 아들 이스마엘과 그와 함께 있던 열 사람이 일어나 사반의 손자 아히감의 아들 그다랴를 칼로 쳤다. 그렇게 그는 바빌론 왕이 그 땅 위에 세운 사람을 죽였다.
ko.B: 그때에 느다냐의 아들 이스마엘과 그와 함께 온 열 사람이 일어나, 사반의 손자요 아히감의 아들인 그다랴를 칼로 쳐 죽였다. 이렇게 그는 바빌론 왕이 그 땅의 총독으로 세운 사람을 죽였다.
ko.R: 그때에 느다냐의 아들 이스마엘과 그와 함께 온 열 사람이 일어나, 사반의 손자요 아히감의 아들인 그다랴를 칼로 공격했다. 이렇게 이스마엘은 바빌론 왕이 그 땅을 맡긴 사람을 죽였다.

pt.L: E Ismael, filho de Netanias, e os dez homens que estavam com ele se levantaram e feriram Gedalias, filho de Aicam, filho de Safã, à espada; e ele matou aquele que o rei da Babilônia tinha posto sobre a terra.
pt.B: Então Ismael, filho de Netanias, e os dez homens que estavam com ele se levantaram e atacaram Gedalias, filho de Aicam, filho de Safã, à espada. Assim ele matou o homem que o rei da Babilônia tinha nomeado governador da terra.
pt.R: Então Ismael, filho de Netanias, e os dez homens que estavam com ele se levantaram e atacaram Gedalias, filho de Aicam, neto de Safã, com as suas espadas. Assim Ismael matou o homem que o rei da Babilônia tinha posto como responsável pela terra.

decisions.choice: they struck ... he put to death: the band attacked, and Ishmael is held responsible
decisions.reason: The first verb is plural, for Ishmael and his ten men; the second is singular. The killing is laid to Ishmael as the leader, as again in verses 16 and 18.

decisions.choice: whom the king of Babylon had appointed over the land: the governor
decisions.reason: The narrator names Gedaliah by his office here and again in verse 18. Killing the man Babylon had set over the land was rebellion against Babylon, which is why the survivors feared reprisal (verse 18; 40:5, 7).

decisions.choice: appointed governor of (Balanced); put in charge of (Readable); with their swords (Readable)
decisions.reason: As in 2 Kings 25:22, Balanced names the office and Readable says what it was. The Hebrew says "with the sword", meaning swords as weapons; Readable makes it plain that the men used their own.

decisions.choice: tổng đốc (B)
decisions.reason: The governor (*pechah*) is "tổng đốc", as 2 Kings 25:22 B has it and the terms note sets.

decisions.choice: nomeado governador (B); posto como responsável (R)
decisions.reason: As 2 Kings 25:22 says it in Portuguese (m2): Balanced names the office, Readable says what it was. Readable says "neto de Safã" for the second "filho", as there.

source.text: וְאֵ֣ת כָּל־הַיְּהוּדִ֗ים אֲשֶׁר־הָי֨וּ אִתּ֤וֹ אֶת־גְּדַלְיָ֨הוּ֙ בַּמִּצְפָּ֔ה וְאֶת־הַכַּשְׂדִּ֖ים אֲשֶׁ֣ר נִמְצְאוּ־שָׁ֑ם אֵ֚ת אַנְשֵׁ֣י הַמִּלְחָמָ֔ה הִכָּ֖ה יִשְׁמָעֵֽאל׃

records.literal_gloss: And all the Judeans who were with him, with Gedaliah, in Mizpah, and the Chaldeans who were found there, the men of the war, struck Ishmael.

en.L: And all the Judeans who were with him, with Gedaliah, at Mizpah, and the Chaldeans who were found there, the men of war, Ishmael struck down.
en.B: Ishmael also struck down all the Judeans who were with Gedaliah at Mizpah, and the Chaldean soldiers who happened to be there.
en.R: Ishmael also killed all the people of Judah who were with Gedaliah at Mizpah. He killed the Babylonian soldiers who were there too.

es.L: Y a todos los judíos que estaban con él, con Gedalías, en Mizpa, y a los caldeos que se hallaban allí, los hombres de guerra, los hirió Ismael.
es.B: Ismael mató también a todos los judíos que estaban con Gedalías en Mizpa, y a los soldados caldeos que se encontraban allí.
es.R: Ismael también mató a toda la gente de Judá que estaba con Gedalías en Mizpa. Mató además a los soldados babilonios que estaban allí.

fr.L: Et tous les Judéens qui étaient avec lui, avec Guedalia, à Mitspa, et les Chaldéens qui se trouvaient là, les hommes de guerre, Ismaël les frappa.
fr.B: Ismaël abattit aussi tous les Judéens qui étaient avec Guedalia à Mitspa, et les soldats chaldéens qui se trouvaient là.
fr.R: Ismaël a aussi tué tous les gens de Juda qui étaient avec Guedalia à Mitspa. Il a tué aussi les soldats babyloniens qui se trouvaient là.

sw.L: Na Wayahudi wote waliokuwa pamoja naye, pamoja na Gedalia, huko Mizpa, na Wakaldayo walioonekana huko, watu wa vita, Ishmaeli akawapiga.
sw.B: Ishmaeli aliwapiga pia Wayahudi wote waliokuwa pamoja na Gedalia huko Mizpa, na askari wa Wakaldayo waliokuwa huko.
sw.R: Ishmaeli aliwaua pia watu wote wa Yuda waliokuwa pamoja na Gedalia huko Mizpa. Aliwaua pia askari wa Babeli waliokuwa huko.

vi.L: Còn tất cả người Giu-đa ở với hắn, với Ghê-đa-lia, tại Mích-ba, và người Canh-đê có mặt ở đó, là quân lính, Ích-ma-ên đều đánh giết.
vi.B: Ích-ma-ên cũng giết tất cả người Giu-đa ở với Ghê-đa-lia tại Mích-ba, cùng những quân lính Canh-đê có mặt ở đó.
vi.R: Ích-ma-ên cũng giết tất cả người Giu-đa ở với Ghê-đa-lia tại Mích-ba. Hắn giết luôn cả những quân lính Ba-by-lôn có mặt ở đó.

ko.L: 그리고 미스바에서 그와, 곧 그다랴와 함께 있던 모든 유다 사람과, 거기에서 발견된 갈대아 사람들, 곧 군사들을 이스마엘이 쳐 죽였다.
ko.B: 이스마엘은 또 미스바에서 그다랴와 함께 있던 모든 유다 사람과, 마침 거기에 있던 갈대아 군인들도 쳐 죽였다.
ko.R: 이스마엘은 또 미스바에서 그다랴와 함께 있던 유다 사람들을 모두 죽였다. 그곳에 있던 바빌로니아 군인들도 죽였다.

pt.L: E todos os judeus que estavam com ele, com Gedalias, em Mispá, e os caldeus que se acharam ali, os homens de guerra, Ismael [os] feriu.
pt.B: Ismael matou também todos os judeus que estavam com Gedalias em Mispá e os soldados caldeus que por acaso estavam ali.
pt.R: Ismael também matou todas as pessoas de Judá que estavam com Gedalias em Mispá. E matou também os soldados babilônios que estavam ali.

decisions.choice: the Chaldeans ..., the men of war: the Babylonian soldiers
decisions.reason: "The men of war" follows the Chaldeans with no "and", so it says who they were: soldiers stationed at Mizpah. It is not a third group of Judean soldiers, for some Judean fighting men were still alive afterward (verse 16).

decisions.choice: all the Judeans who were with him: those in Gedaliah's company
decisions.reason: "All" means the people with Gedaliah at the time, his household and attendants. Many other people of Judah remained in Mizpah, and Ishmael took them captive (verse 10).

decisions.choice: as 2 Kings 25:25, which does not say they were soldiers
decisions.reason: 2 Kings 25:25 names "the Judeans and the Chaldeans who were with him at Mizpah". Jeremiah adds that the Chaldeans were men of war who happened to be there.

decisions.choice: Ishmael ... struck down (Balanced); Ishmael also killed (Readable); people of Judah, Babylonian (Readable)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew puts the victims first and the subject and verb last, for emphasis; Literal keeps that order. Balanced and Readable start with Ishmael. Readable says "people of Judah" for Judeans and "Babylonian" for Chaldean, as in Isaiah.

decisions.choice: os judeus (L, B), as pessoas de Judá (R); os caldeus (L, B), babilônios (R)
decisions.reason: For the whole book: the Judeans are "os judeus", the people of Judah, as 2 Kings 25:25 has them in Portuguese; "judaítas" is rare in Portuguese. Readable says "as pessoas de Judá", as the English Readable says "people of Judah". The Chaldeans are "os caldeus" at Literal and Balanced and "os babilônios" at Readable, as 2 Kings 25:4 sets it.

source.text: וַיְהִ֛י בַּיּ֥וֹם הַשֵּׁנִ֖י לְהָמִ֣ית אֶת־גְּדַלְיָ֑הוּ וְאִ֖ישׁ לֹ֥א יָדָֽע׃

records.literal_gloss: And it was on the day the second after putting to death Gedaliah, and a man not knew,

en.L: And it came about on the second day after he had put Gedaliah to death, and no one knew [it],
en.B: On the day after Gedaliah's murder, before anyone knew about it,
en.R: The day after Gedaliah was killed, no one knew about it yet.

es.L: Y sucedió al día siguiente de haber dado muerte a Gedalías, cuando nadie [lo] sabía todavía,
es.B: Al día siguiente del asesinato de Gedalías, antes de que nadie lo supiera,
es.R: El día después de la muerte de Gedalías, nadie sabía todavía lo que había pasado.

fr.L: Et il arriva, le deuxième jour après qu’il eut fait mourir Guedalia, alors que personne ne [le] savait,
fr.B: Le lendemain du meurtre de Guedalia, avant que personne ne le sache,
fr.R: Le lendemain de la mort de Guedalia, personne ne savait encore rien.

sw.L: Ikawa siku ya pili baada ya kumwua Gedalia, wala hakuna mtu aliyejua,
sw.B: Siku iliyofuata baada ya Gedalia kuuawa, kabla mtu yeyote hajajua habari hiyo,
sw.R: Siku iliyofuata baada ya Gedalia kuuawa, hakuna mtu aliyekuwa amejua bado.

vi.L: Xảy ra vào ngày thứ hai sau khi hắn giết Ghê-đa-lia, mà chưa ai biết [điều ấy],
vi.B: Ngày hôm sau vụ sát hại Ghê-đa-lia, khi chưa ai hay biết,
vi.R: Ngày hôm sau khi Ghê-đa-lia bị giết, vẫn chưa ai biết chuyện ấy.

ko.L: 그리고 그가 그다랴를 죽인 지 이튿날, 아무도 [그것을] 알지 못하고 있었는데,
ko.B: 그다랴가 살해된 다음 날, 아직 아무도 그 일을 알지 못하고 있을 때에,
ko.R: 그다랴가 죽은 다음 날이었다. 아직 아무도 그 일을 알지 못했다.

pt.L: E aconteceu, no segundo dia depois de ele ter matado Gedalias, e ninguém [o] sabia,
pt.B: No dia seguinte ao assassinato de Gedalias, antes que alguém soubesse do que tinha acontecido,
pt.R: No dia seguinte à morte de Gedalias, ninguém ainda sabia do que tinha acontecido.

decisions.choice: the second day: the next day
decisions.reason: Counting the day of the murder as the first, "the second day" is the day after it.

decisions.choice: and no one knew: the murder was still a secret
decisions.reason: This clause describes the situation: no one outside had yet heard what had happened. It explains how the men in the next verse could walk into Mizpah unwarned.

decisions.choice: a sentence of its own (Readable)
decisions.reason: Literal and Balanced end with a comma, because the sentence runs on into verse 5. Readable makes this verse a sentence by itself.

source.text: וַיָּבֹ֣אוּ אֲ֠נָשִׁים מִשְּׁכֶ֞ם מִשִּׁל֤וֹ וּמִשֹּֽׁמְרוֹן֙ שְׁמֹנִ֣ים אִ֔ישׁ מְגֻלְּחֵ֥י זָקָ֛ן וּקְרֻעֵ֥י בְגָדִ֖ים וּמִתְגֹּֽדְדִ֑ים וּמִנְחָ֤ה וּלְבוֹנָה֙ בְּיָדָ֔ם לְהָבִ֖יא בֵּ֥ית יְהוָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: and came men from Shechem, from Shiloh, and from Samaria, eighty man, shaven of beard and torn of clothes and cutting themselves, and grain offering and frankincense in their hand to bring [to the] house of Yahweh.

en.L: and men came from Shechem, from Shiloh and from Samaria, eighty men, with beards shaved and clothes torn and gashing themselves, and [with] grain offering and frankincense in their hand to bring [to] the house of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.B: eighty men arrived from Shechem, Shiloh and Samaria. Their beards were shaved, their clothes torn and their bodies gashed, and they were carrying grain offerings and frankincense to bring to the house of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.R: Eighty men came from the towns of Shechem, Shiloh and Samaria. They had shaved off their beards, torn their clothes and cut their skin to show their grief. They were carrying grain offerings and incense to offer at the temple of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.

es.L: que vinieron hombres de Siquem, de Silo y de Samaria, ochenta hombres, con la barba rapada y los vestidos rasgados y haciéndose cortes, y [con] ofrenda de cereal e incienso en su mano para llevar[los] a la casa {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}.
es.B: llegaron ochenta hombres de Siquem, Silo y Samaria. Traían la barba rapada, la ropa rasgada y el cuerpo lleno de cortes, y llevaban ofrendas de cereal e incienso para presentarlas en la casa {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}.
es.R: Ochenta hombres llegaron de las ciudades de Siquem, Silo y Samaria. Se habían afeitado la barba, se habían rasgado la ropa y se habían hecho cortes en la piel en señal de dolor. Llevaban ofrendas de cereal e incienso para ofrecerlos en el templo {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}.

fr.L: que des hommes vinrent de Sichem, de Silo et de Samarie, quatre-vingts hommes, la barbe rasée, les vêtements déchirés et se faisant des incisions, et [avec] une offrande de céréales et de l’encens dans leur main, pour [les] apporter à la maison {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}.
fr.B: quatre-vingts hommes arrivèrent de Sichem, de Silo et de Samarie. Ils avaient la barbe rasée, les vêtements déchirés et le corps couvert d’incisions, et ils portaient des offrandes de céréales et de l’encens pour les apporter à la maison {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}.
fr.R: Quatre-vingts hommes sont venus des villes de Sichem, de Silo et de Samarie. Ils s’étaient rasé la barbe, avaient déchiré leurs vêtements et s’étaient fait des entailles sur la peau pour montrer leur deuil. Ils portaient des offrandes de céréales et de l’encens pour les offrir au temple {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}.

sw.L: watu wakaja kutoka Shekemu, kutoka Shilo na kutoka Samaria, watu themanini, wenye ndevu zilizonyolewa na mavazi yaliyoraruliwa, wakijikatakata, [wakiwa na] sadaka ya unga na ubani mkononi mwao kuvileta [katika] nyumba ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.B: watu themanini walifika kutoka Shekemu, Shilo na Samaria. Walikuwa wamenyoa ndevu zao, wamerarua mavazi yao na kujikatakata miili yao, nao walikuwa wamebeba sadaka za unga na ubani ili kuvileta katika nyumba ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.R: Watu themanini walikuja kutoka miji ya Shekemu, Shilo na Samaria. Walikuwa wamenyoa ndevu zao, wamerarua mavazi yao na kujikata ngozi kuonyesha huzuni yao. Walikuwa wamebeba sadaka za unga na uvumba ili kuzitoa katika hekalu la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.

vi.L: có những người từ Si-chem, từ Si-lô và từ Sa-ma-ri đến, tám mươi người, râu cạo, áo xé và mình rạch, tay cầm của lễ chay và nhũ hương để đem [đến] nhà của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.
vi.B: thì có tám mươi người từ Si-chem, Si-lô và Sa-ma-ri đến. Họ đã cạo râu, xé áo và rạch mình, và mang theo của lễ chay cùng nhũ hương để dâng tại nhà của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.
vi.R: Có tám mươi người từ các thành Si-chem, Si-lô và Sa-ma-ri đến. Họ đã cạo râu, xé áo và rạch da để tỏ lòng thương tiếc. Họ mang theo của lễ ngũ cốc và hương để dâng tại đền thờ của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.

ko.L: 세겜과 실로와 사마리아에서 사람들이 왔는데, 팔십 명이었다. 그들은 수염을 깎고 옷을 찢고 몸에 상처를 낸 채, {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 집에 가져가려고 곡식 제물과 유향을 손에 [들고 있었다].
ko.B: 세겜과 실로와 사마리아에서 80명이 왔다. 그들은 수염을 깎고 옷을 찢고 몸에 상처를 낸 채, {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 집에 바치려고 곡식 제물과 유향을 들고 오는 길이었다.
ko.R: 세겜과 실로와 사마리아 성읍에서 80명이 왔다. 그들은 슬픔을 나타내려고 수염을 깎고 옷을 찢고 몸에 상처를 냈다. 그들은 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 성전에 바치려고 곡식 제물과 향을 들고 있었다.

pt.L: vieram homens de Siquém, de Siló e de Samaria, oitenta homens, com a barba raspada, e as roupas rasgadas, e fazendo cortes em si mesmos, e [com] oferta de cereal e incenso na mão, para levar à casa {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}.
pt.B: chegaram oitenta homens de Siquém, de Siló e de Samaria. Estavam com a barba raspada, as roupas rasgadas e o corpo cheio de cortes, e traziam ofertas de cereal e incenso para levar à casa {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}.
pt.R: Oitenta homens vieram das cidades de Siquém, Siló e Samaria. Eles tinham raspado a barba, rasgado as roupas e feito cortes na pele para mostrar a sua tristeza. Estavam levando ofertas de cereal e incenso para oferecer no templo {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}.

decisions.choice: Shechem, Shiloh and Samaria: towns of the former northern kingdom
decisions.reason: All three lay in the old territory of Israel to the north, which Assyria had conquered long before (2 Kings 17:5-6). Some people there still came to worship the LORD at Jerusalem (2 Chronicles 30:11; 34:9).

decisions.choice: shaved beards, torn clothes and gashed bodies: signs of mourning
decisions.reason: These were the customs of grief in that world (16:6; 47:5; 48:37). The law forbade gashing the body for the dead (Leviticus 19:28; Deuteronomy 14:1), but the practice went on. The men were most likely mourning the fall of Jerusalem and the burning of the temple.

decisions.choice: grain offering and frankincense for the house of the LORD: gifts brought to the ruined temple
alternatives: a place of worship at Mizpah
decisions.reason: The temple had been burned (52:13), yet these men were still bringing offerings to the place where it had stood. They bring grain and frankincense, not animals for sacrifice. Some think "the house of the LORD" here means a place of worship at Mizpah, but the phrase usually means the temple in Jerusalem, and Mizpah lay on the road there from the north.

decisions.choice: to show their grief; incense (Readable)
decisions.reason: Readable says why the men had done these things (m2) and uses the plain word "incense" for frankincense.

decisions.choice: eighty men arrived (Balanced); a new sentence (Readable)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew gives the places first and the number after. Balanced and Readable put the number first and describe the men in a sentence of their own.

decisions.choice: en señal de dolor
decisions.reason: Readable says why the men had shaved and cut themselves: these were signs of mourning, here for the fallen temple.

decisions.choice: để tỏ lòng thương tiếc (R)
decisions.reason: Readable says that the shaved beards, torn clothes and gashes were signs of mourning, as the English Readable does.
Numbers of people in figures at Balanced and Readable as the terms note sets; Literal writes this count in words, as the Kings Literal does for small counts.

decisions.choice: incenso
decisions.reason: Frankincense is "incenso" in ordinary Portuguese at every level; "olíbano", the resin's own name, is a specialist's word.

source.text: וַ֠יֵּצֵא יִשְׁמָעֵ֨אל בֶּן־נְתַנְיָ֤ה לִקְרָאתָם֙ מִן־הַמִּצְפָּ֔ה הֹלֵ֥ךְ הָלֹ֖ךְ וּבֹכֶ֑ה וַֽיְהִי֙ כִּפְגֹ֣שׁ אֹתָ֔ם וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֲלֵיהֶ֔ם בֹּ֖אוּ אֶל־גְּדַלְיָ֥הוּ בֶן־אֲחִיקָֽם׃ס

records.literal_gloss: And went out Ishmael son of Nethaniah to meet them from Mizpah, going going and weeping; and it was as meeting them, and he said to them, Come to Gedaliah son of Ahikam.

en.L: And Ishmael son of Nethaniah went out from Mizpah to meet them, going along and weeping; and it came about, as he met them, [that] he said to them, "Come to Gedaliah son of Ahikam."
en.B: Ishmael son of Nethaniah left Mizpah to meet them, weeping as he went along. When he met them, he said to them, "Come to Gedaliah son of Ahikam."
en.R: Ishmael son of Nethaniah went out from Mizpah to meet them. He cried as he walked along. When he met them, he said, "Come and see Gedaliah son of Ahikam."

es.L: Y salió de Mizpa a su encuentro Ismael hijo de Netanías, andando y llorando; y sucedió que, cuando los encontró, les dijo: «{{plural_you:Vengan|Venid}} a Gedalías hijo de Ahicam».
es.B: Ismael hijo de Netanías salió de Mizpa a recibirlos, llorando mientras caminaba. Cuando los encontró, les dijo: «{{plural_you:Vengan|Venid}} a ver a Gedalías hijo de Ahicam».
es.R: Ismael hijo de Netanías salió de Mizpa a recibirlos. Iba llorando mientras caminaba. Cuando los encontró, les dijo: «{{plural_you:Vengan|Venid}} a ver a Gedalías hijo de Ahicam».

fr.L: Et Ismaël fils de Netania sortit de Mitspa à leur rencontre, marchant et pleurant ; et il arriva, quand il les rencontra, [qu’]il leur dit : « Venez auprès de Guedalia fils d’Ahiqam. »
fr.B: Ismaël fils de Netania sortit de Mitspa à leur rencontre, en pleurant tout le long du chemin. Quand il les rencontra, il leur dit : « Venez auprès de Guedalia fils d’Ahiqam. »
fr.R: Ismaël fils de Netania est sorti de Mitspa pour aller à leur rencontre. Il pleurait en marchant. Quand il les a rencontrés, il leur a dit : « Venez voir Guedalia fils d’Ahiqam. »

sw.L: Naye Ishmaeli mwana wa Nethania akatoka Mizpa kwenda kuwalaki, akienda huku akilia; ikawa alipokutana nao, akawaambia, "Njooni kwa Gedalia mwana wa Ahikamu."
sw.B: Ishmaeli mwana wa Nethania alitoka Mizpa kwenda kuwalaki, akilia njiani. Alipokutana nao, akawaambia, "Njooni kwa Gedalia mwana wa Ahikamu."
sw.R: Ishmaeli mwana wa Nethania alitoka Mizpa kwenda kuwalaki. Alilia huku akitembea. Alipokutana nao, akasema, "Njooni mkamwone Gedalia mwana wa Ahikamu."

vi.L: Ích-ma-ên con trai Nê-tha-nia ra khỏi Mích-ba để đón họ, vừa đi vừa khóc; và xảy ra, khi gặp họ, hắn nói với họ: "Hãy đến với Ghê-đa-lia con trai A-hi-cam."
vi.B: Ích-ma-ên con trai Nê-tha-nia rời Mích-ba ra đón họ, vừa đi vừa khóc. Khi gặp họ, hắn nói: "Hãy đến với Ghê-đa-lia con trai A-hi-cam."
vi.R: Ích-ma-ên con trai Nê-tha-nia ra khỏi Mích-ba để đón họ. Hắn vừa đi vừa khóc. Khi gặp họ, hắn nói: "Hãy đến gặp Ghê-đa-lia con trai A-hi-cam."

ko.L: 그리고 느다냐의 아들 이스마엘이 미스바에서 나가 그들을 맞으러 계속 울면서 갔다. 그리고 그가 그들을 만났을 때 그들에게 말했다. "아히감의 아들 그다랴에게 갑시다."
ko.B: 느다냐의 아들 이스마엘은 그들을 맞으러 미스바에서 나가면서 줄곧 울며 걸어갔다. 그는 그들을 만나자 그들에게 말했다. "아히감의 아들 그다랴에게 갑시다."
ko.R: 느다냐의 아들 이스마엘은 그들을 맞으러 미스바에서 나갔다. 그는 걸어가면서 울었다. 그는 그들을 만나자 말했다. "아히감의 아들 그다랴를 만나러 갑시다."

pt.L: E Ismael, filho de Netanias, saiu de Mispá ao encontro deles, andando e chorando; e aconteceu que, ao encontrá-los, disse-lhes: "Venham a Gedalias, filho de Aicam."
pt.B: Ismael, filho de Netanias, saiu de Mispá para encontrá-los, chorando enquanto andava. Quando os encontrou, disse a eles: "Venham até Gedalias, filho de Aicam."
pt.R: Ismael, filho de Netanias, saiu de Mispá para encontrar esses homens. Ele ia chorando pelo caminho. Quando os encontrou, disse: "Venham ver Gedalias, filho de Aicam."

decisions.choice: going along and weeping: Ishmael wept all the way
alternatives: the eighty men were weeping as they went
decisions.reason: The repeated verb "going, going" shows action that goes on, and "weeping" goes with it. The Greek translation is reported to say that the men were the ones weeping; the Hebrew says it of Ishmael.

decisions.choice: his weeping and his invitation: a deception
decisions.reason: Ishmael pretended to share their grief, and he invited them to the governor, hiding that Gedaliah was already dead. Both were meant to lead them into the town without suspicion.

decisions.choice: Come and see (Readable)
decisions.reason: "Come to Gedaliah" invites them to visit him. Readable says it in everyday words.

decisions.choice: Ishmael speaks to the pilgrims in 하오체 ("갑시다"); the ten men beg him in 합쇼체 (verse 8)
decisions.reason: A false welcome between grown men who do not know each other; the men who plead for their lives speak to him with respect.

source.text: וַיְהִ֕י כְּבוֹאָ֖ם אֶל־תּ֣וֹךְ הָעִ֑יר וַיִּשְׁחָטֵ֞ם יִשְׁמָעֵ֤אל בֶּן־נְתַנְיָה֙ אֶל־תּ֣וֹךְ הַבּ֔וֹר ה֖וּא וְהָאֲנָשִׁ֥ים אֲשֶׁר־אִתּֽוֹ׃

records.literal_gloss: And it was as their coming into [the] midst of the city, and slaughtered them Ishmael son of Nethaniah into [the] midst of the cistern, he and the men who [were] with him.

en.L: And it came about, when they came into the middle of the city, [that] Ishmael son of Nethaniah slaughtered them [and threw them] into the middle of the cistern, he and the men who [were] with him.
en.B: But as soon as they were inside the city, Ishmael son of Nethaniah and his men slaughtered them and threw them into the cistern.
en.R: But as soon as they were inside the town, Ishmael and his men killed them. They threw the bodies into a cistern, a pit dug to hold water.

es.L: Y sucedió que, cuando llegaron al centro de la ciudad, Ismael hijo de Netanías los degolló [y los echó] dentro de la cisterna, él y los hombres que [estaban] con él.
es.B: Pero en cuanto entraron en la ciudad, Ismael hijo de Netanías y sus hombres los degollaron y los echaron en la cisterna.
es.R: Pero en cuanto entraron en la ciudad, Ismael y sus hombres los mataron. Echaron los cuerpos en una cisterna, un pozo hecho para guardar agua.

fr.L: Et il arriva, quand ils furent arrivés au milieu de la ville, [qu’]Ismaël fils de Netania les égorgea [et les jeta] au milieu de la citerne, lui et les hommes qui [étaient] avec lui.
fr.B: Mais dès qu’ils furent entrés dans la ville, Ismaël fils de Netania et ses hommes les égorgèrent et les jetèrent dans la citerne.
fr.R: Mais dès qu’ils sont entrés dans la ville, Ismaël et ses hommes les ont tués. Ils ont jeté les corps dans une citerne, une fosse creusée pour garder l’eau.

sw.L: Ikawa walipoingia katikati ya mji, Ishmaeli mwana wa Nethania akawachinja [na kuwatupa] katikati ya birika, yeye na watu waliokuwa pamoja naye.
sw.B: Lakini mara walipoingia mjini, Ishmaeli mwana wa Nethania na watu wake wakawachinja, wakawatupa ndani ya birika.
sw.R: Lakini mara walipoingia mjini, Ishmaeli na watu wake waliwaua. Wakaitupa miili yao ndani ya birika, shimo lililochimbwa kuhifadhi maji.

vi.L: Xảy ra, khi họ vào giữa thành, Ích-ma-ên con trai Nê-tha-nia giết họ [và quăng họ] vào giữa hố chứa nước, hắn và những người ở với hắn.
vi.B: Nhưng vừa khi họ vào trong thành, Ích-ma-ên con trai Nê-tha-nia và người của hắn tàn sát họ và quăng xác xuống hố chứa nước.
vi.R: Nhưng vừa khi họ vào trong thành, Ích-ma-ên và người của hắn giết họ. Chúng quăng xác họ xuống một cái hố đào để chứa nước.

ko.L: 그리고 그들이 성 한가운데로 들어왔을 때, 느다냐의 아들 이스마엘이 그들을 죽여 웅덩이 한가운데로 [던졌다]. 그와 그와 함께 있던 사람들이 그렇게 했다.
ko.B: 그러나 그들이 성 안으로 들어오자마자, 느다냐의 아들 이스마엘과 그의 부하들은 그들을 죽여 물웅덩이에 던져 넣었다.
ko.R: 그러나 그들이 성 안으로 들어오자마자, 이스마엘과 그의 부하들은 그들을 죽였다. 그리고 그 시체들을 물웅덩이, 곧 물을 모아 두려고 판 구덩이에 던져 넣었다.

pt.L: E aconteceu que, quando entraram no meio da cidade, Ismael, filho de Netanias, os degolou [e os lançou] no meio da cisterna, ele e os homens que [estavam] com ele.
pt.B: Mas, assim que eles entraram na cidade, Ismael, filho de Netanias, e os seus homens os massacraram e os jogaram na cisterna.
pt.R: Mas, assim que eles entraram na cidade, Ismael e os seus homens os mataram. Depois jogaram os corpos numa cisterna, um poço cavado para guardar água.

decisions.choice: slaughtered them into the cistern: killed them and threw them in
decisions.reason: The Hebrew joins the killing and the place the bodies ended up in one short phrase. Verse 9 says plainly that Ishmael threw the bodies into the cistern.

decisions.choice: slaughtered: killed like animals
decisions.reason: The verb is the one used for slaughtering animals, often for sacrifice. Men who had come to bring offerings were themselves butchered.

decisions.choice: he and the men who were with him: his ten men shared in it
decisions.reason: The words come at the end of the sentence and add Ishmael's band to the deed.

decisions.choice: [and threw them] (Literal); and threw them (Balanced); They threw the bodies into a cistern, a pit dug to hold water (Readable)
decisions.reason: English needs a verb for the bodies going into the cistern (m1). Readable explains what a cistern is. Readable shortens Ishmael's name, which is given in full just before.

decisions.choice: [y los echó] (L); y los echaron (B); Echaron los cuerpos en una cisterna (R)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew says he slaughtered them "into the cistern"; a verb of throwing is supplied, in brackets at Literal.

decisions.choice: degolou (L); massacraram (B)
decisions.reason: The verb is the one for slaughtering animals (m2). Literal says "degolou", as 2 Kings 25:7 does for the same verb in Portuguese, and Balanced "massacraram", which keeps the brutality the English "slaughtered" keeps.

source.text: וַעֲשָׂרָ֨ה אֲנָשִׁ֜ים נִמְצְאוּ־בָ֗ם וַיֹּאמְר֤וּ אֶל־יִשְׁמָעֵאל֙ אַל־תְּמִתֵ֔נוּ כִּֽי־יֶשׁ־לָ֤נוּ מַטְמֹנִים֙ בַּשָּׂדֶ֔ה חִטִּ֥ים וּשְׂעֹרִ֖ים וְשֶׁ֣מֶן וּדְבָ֑שׁ וַיֶּחְדַּ֕ל וְלֹ֥א הֱמִיתָ֖ם בְּת֥וֹךְ אֲחֵיהֶֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: And ten men were found among them, and they said to Ishmael, Do not kill us, for there are to us hidden stores in the field, wheat and barley and oil and honey; and he refrained and not killed them in [the] midst of their brothers.

en.L: And ten men were found among them, and they said to Ishmael, "Do not kill us, for we have hidden stores in the field: wheat and barley and oil and honey." And he refrained and did not kill them among their brothers.
en.B: But there were ten men among them who said to Ishmael, "Do not kill us! We have stores of wheat, barley, oil and honey hidden in the countryside." So he held back and did not kill them along with their companions.
en.R: But ten of the men said to Ishmael, "Do not kill us! We have wheat, barley, olive oil and honey hidden out in the fields." So Ishmael let them live and did not kill them with the others.

es.L: Pero se hallaron entre ellos diez hombres que dijeron a Ismael: «No nos mates, porque tenemos escondidos en el campo trigo, cebada, aceite y miel». Y se detuvo y no los mató en medio de sus hermanos.
es.B: Pero entre ellos había diez hombres que le dijeron a Ismael: «¡No nos mates! Tenemos provisiones de trigo, cebada, aceite y miel escondidas en el campo». Entonces él se contuvo y no los mató junto con sus compañeros.
es.R: Pero diez de los hombres le dijeron a Ismael: «¡No nos mates! Tenemos trigo, cebada, aceite de oliva y miel escondidos en el campo». Así que Ismael los dejó vivir y no los mató con los demás.

fr.L: Et il se trouva parmi eux dix hommes, et ils dirent à Ismaël : « Ne nous fais pas mourir, car nous avons dans les champs des provisions cachées : du blé, de l’orge, de l’huile et du miel. » Et il s’abstint et ne les fit pas mourir au milieu de leurs frères.
fr.B: Mais il y avait parmi eux dix hommes qui dirent à Ismaël : « Ne nous tue pas ! Nous avons des réserves de blé, d’orge, d’huile et de miel cachées dans la campagne. » Alors il les épargna et ne les tua pas avec leurs compagnons.
fr.R: Mais dix de ces hommes ont dit à Ismaël : « Ne nous tue pas ! Nous avons du blé, de l’orge, de l’huile d’olive et du miel cachés dans les champs. » Alors Ismaël les a laissés vivre et ne les a pas tués avec les autres.

sw.L: Lakini watu kumi walionekana kati yao, wakamwambia Ishmaeli, "Usituue, kwa maana tuna akiba iliyofichwa shambani: ngano na shayiri na mafuta na asali." Naye akaacha, wala hakuwaua pamoja na ndugu zao.
sw.B: Lakini kulikuwa na watu kumi kati yao waliomwambia Ishmaeli, "Usituue! Tuna akiba ya ngano, shayiri, mafuta na asali iliyofichwa mashambani." Basi akaacha, wala hakuwaua pamoja na wenzao.
sw.R: Lakini watu kumi kati yao walimwambia Ishmaeli, "Usituue! Tuna ngano, shayiri, mafuta ya zeituni na asali tuliyoificha huko mashambani." Basi Ishmaeli akawaacha waishi, wala hakuwaua pamoja na wengine.

vi.L: Nhưng có mười người trong số họ nói với Ích-ma-ên: "Xin đừng giết chúng tôi, vì chúng tôi có những kho dự trữ giấu ngoài đồng: lúa mì, lúa mạch, dầu và mật." Hắn dừng tay, không giết họ giữa anh em họ.
vi.B: Nhưng có mười người trong số họ nói với Ích-ma-ên: "Xin đừng giết chúng tôi! Chúng tôi có lúa mì, lúa mạch, dầu và mật giấu ở ngoài đồng." Vậy hắn dừng tay, không giết họ cùng với đồng bạn của họ.
vi.R: Nhưng mười người trong số đó nói với Ích-ma-ên: "Xin đừng giết chúng tôi! Chúng tôi có lúa mì, lúa mạch, dầu ô-liu và mật ong giấu ngoài đồng." Vậy Ích-ma-ên tha cho họ sống, không giết họ cùng với những người kia.

ko.L: 그런데 그들 가운데 열 사람이 있었는데, 그들이 이스마엘에게 말했다. "우리를 죽이지 마십시오. 우리에게는 들에 숨겨 둔 밀과 보리와 기름과 꿀이 있습니다." 그래서 그가 그만두고 그들을 그들의 형제들 가운데서 죽이지 않았다.
ko.B: 그러나 그들 가운데 열 사람이 이스마엘에게 말했다. "우리를 죽이지 마십시오! 우리에게는 들판에 숨겨 둔 밀과 보리와 기름과 꿀이 있습니다." 그래서 이스마엘은 손을 멈추고, 그들을 동료들과 함께 죽이지 않았다.
ko.R: 그러나 그 가운데 열 사람이 이스마엘에게 말했다. "우리를 죽이지 마십시오! 우리는 밀과 보리와 올리브기름과 꿀을 들판에 숨겨 두었습니다." 그래서 이스마엘은 그들을 살려 주고, 다른 사람들과 함께 죽이지 않았다.

pt.L: Mas dez homens se acharam entre eles, e disseram a Ismael: "Não nos mate, porque temos provisões escondidas no campo: trigo, e cevada, e azeite, e mel." E ele se conteve e não os matou no meio dos seus irmãos.
pt.B: Mas havia entre eles dez homens que disseram a Ismael: "Não nos mate! Temos trigo, cevada, azeite e mel escondidos no campo." Então ele se conteve e não os matou junto com os seus companheiros.
pt.R: Mas dez daqueles homens disseram a Ismael: "Não nos mate! Temos trigo, cevada, azeite e mel escondidos lá nos campos." Então Ismael deixou que eles vivessem e não os matou com os outros.

decisions.choice: hidden stores in the field: food buried for safe keeping
decisions.reason: Grain, oil and honey were kept in pits and jars hidden in the open country, out of reach of raiders. After war and siege, food was precious, and the ten men bought their lives with it.

decisions.choice: their brothers: their companions
decisions.reason: "Brothers" here means the other men in their group, their fellow countrymen.

decisions.choice: honey: perhaps a syrup made from fruit
decisions.reason: The word can mean bees' honey or a thick syrup from dates or grapes. Either fits a store of food.

decisions.choice: countryside (Balanced); out in the fields, olive oil, let them live, the others (Readable); companions (Balanced)
decisions.reason: "Field" means open country outside the town. Readable names the kind of oil and says plainly what "refrained" meant for the ten men.

source.text: וְהַבּ֗וֹר אֲשֶׁר֩ הִשְׁלִ֨יךְ שָׁ֤ם יִשְׁמָעֵאל֙ אֵ֣ת׀כָּל־פִּגְרֵ֣י הָאֲנָשִׁ֗ים אֲשֶׁ֤ר הִכָּה֙ בְּיַד־גְּדַלְיָ֔הוּ ה֗וּא אֲשֶׁ֤ר עָשָׂה֙ הַמֶּ֣לֶךְ אָסָ֔א מִפְּנֵ֖י בַּעְשָׁ֣א מֶֽלֶךְ־יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל אֹת֗וֹ מִלֵּ֛א יִשְׁמָעֵ֥אל בֶּן־נְתַנְיָ֖הוּ חֲלָלִֽים׃

records.literal_gloss: And the cistern where threw there Ishmael all [the] corpses of the men whom he struck by [the] hand of Gedaliah, it [was] which made the king Asa from [the] face of Baasha king of Israel; it filled Ishmael son of Nethaniah [with the] slain.

en.L: And the cistern where Ishmael threw all the corpses of the men whom he had struck down by the hand of Gedaliah, it [was the one] that King Asa had made because of Baasha king of Israel; Ishmael son of Nethaniah filled it [with the] slain.
en.B: The cistern where Ishmael threw the bodies of all the men he had struck down along with Gedaliah was the one King Asa had made for defense against Baasha king of Israel. Ishmael son of Nethaniah filled it with those he had killed.
en.R: Ishmael threw the bodies of all the men he had killed along with Gedaliah into a cistern. King Asa had made it long before, when he was afraid of an attack by Baasha king of Israel. Ishmael son of Nethaniah filled it with dead bodies.

es.L: Y la cisterna donde Ismael echó todos los cadáveres de los hombres que había herido junto con Gedalías [era] la que hizo el rey Asa a causa de Baasa, rey de Israel; Ismael hijo de Netanías la llenó [de] muertos.
es.B: La cisterna donde Ismael echó los cadáveres de todos los hombres que había matado junto con Gedalías era la que el rey Asa había hecho para defenderse de Baasa, rey de Israel. Ismael hijo de Netanías la llenó de muertos.
es.R: Ismael echó los cuerpos de todos los hombres que había matado junto con Gedalías en una cisterna. El rey Asa la había hecho mucho tiempo antes, cuando tenía miedo de un ataque de Baasa, rey de Israel. Ismael hijo de Netanías la llenó de cadáveres.

fr.L: Et la citerne où Ismaël jeta tous les cadavres des hommes qu’il avait frappés par la main de Guedalia, c’[était celle] qu’avait faite le roi Asa à cause de Baésha, roi d’Israël ; Ismaël fils de Netania la remplit [de] victimes.
fr.B: La citerne où Ismaël jeta les cadavres de tous les hommes qu’il avait abattus avec Guedalia était celle que le roi Asa avait faite pour se défendre contre Baésha, roi d’Israël. Ismaël fils de Netania la remplit de ceux qu’il avait tués.
fr.R: Ismaël a jeté les corps de tous les hommes qu’il avait tués avec Guedalia dans une citerne. Le roi Asa l’avait faite autrefois, quand il craignait une attaque de Baésha, roi d’Israël. Ismaël fils de Netania l’a remplie de cadavres.

sw.L: Na birika lile ambamo Ishmaeli aliitupa maiti yote ya watu aliowapiga kwa mkono wa Gedalia, [ndilo] lile alilolifanya mfalme Asa kwa sababu ya Baasha mfalme wa Israeli; Ishmaeli mwana wa Nethania akalijaza [kwa] waliouawa.
sw.B: Birika ambamo Ishmaeli aliitupa miili ya watu wote aliowaua pamoja na Gedalia ndilo lile ambalo mfalme Asa alilichimba ili kujilinda dhidi ya Baasha mfalme wa Israeli. Ishmaeli mwana wa Nethania alilijaza kwa watu aliowaua.
sw.R: Ishmaeli aliitupa miili ya watu wote aliowaua pamoja na Gedalia ndani ya birika. Mfalme Asa alikuwa amelichimba zamani, alipoogopa kushambuliwa na Baasha mfalme wa Israeli. Ishmaeli mwana wa Nethania alilijaza kwa maiti.

vi.L: Còn hố chứa nước nơi Ích-ma-ên quăng mọi xác chết của những người hắn đã giết cùng với Ghê-đa-lia, đó [là hố] vua A-sa đã làm vì cớ Ba-ê-sa vua Y-sơ-ra-ên; Ích-ma-ên con trai Nê-tha-nia lấp đầy nó [bằng những người] bị giết.
vi.B: Hố chứa nước nơi Ích-ma-ên quăng xác của tất cả những người hắn đã giết cùng với Ghê-đa-lia chính là hố vua A-sa đã làm để phòng thủ chống lại Ba-ê-sa vua Y-sơ-ra-ên. Ích-ma-ên con trai Nê-tha-nia đã lấp đầy hố ấy bằng xác những người bị hắn giết.
vi.R: Ích-ma-ên quăng xác của tất cả những người hắn đã giết cùng với Ghê-đa-lia xuống một hố chứa nước. Hố ấy do vua A-sa làm từ lâu, khi ông sợ Ba-ê-sa vua Y-sơ-ra-ên tấn công. Ích-ma-ên con trai Nê-tha-nia đã lấp đầy hố ấy bằng xác chết.

ko.L: 그리고 이스마엘이 그다랴의 손에 쳐 죽인 사람들의 모든 시체를 던진 웅덩이는, 아사 왕이 이스라엘 왕 바아사 때문에 만든 것이었다. 느다냐의 아들 이스마엘이 그것을 죽은 자들로 채웠다.
ko.B: 이스마엘이 그다랴와 함께 쳐 죽인 사람들의 시체를 모두 던져 넣은 그 물웅덩이는, 아사 왕이 이스라엘 왕 바아사를 막으려고 만든 것이었다. 느다냐의 아들 이스마엘은 그 웅덩이를 자기가 죽인 사람들로 가득 채웠다.
ko.R: 이스마엘은 그다랴와 함께 죽인 사람들의 시체를 모두 물웅덩이에 던져 넣었다. 그 웅덩이는 오래전에 아사 왕이 이스라엘 왕 바아사가 쳐들어올까 봐 두려워서 만든 것이었다. 느다냐의 아들 이스마엘은 그 웅덩이를 시체로 가득 채웠다.

pt.L: E a cisterna onde Ismael lançou todos os cadáveres dos homens que ele tinha ferido pela mão de Gedalias, ela [era a] que o rei Asa tinha feito por causa de Baasa, rei de Israel; Ismael, filho de Netanias, a encheu [de] mortos.
pt.B: A cisterna onde Ismael jogou os corpos de todos os homens que ele tinha matado junto com Gedalias era a que o rei Asa tinha feito para se defender de Baasa, rei de Israel. Ismael, filho de Netanias, a encheu com os que ele tinha matado.
pt.R: Ismael jogou numa cisterna os corpos de todos os homens que ele tinha matado junto com Gedalias. Muito tempo antes, o rei Asa tinha feito essa cisterna, quando teve medo de um ataque de Baasa, rei de Israel. Ismael, filho de Netanias, encheu a cisterna de corpos.

decisions.choice: by the hand of Gedaliah: along with Gedaliah
alternatives: by means of Gedaliah, using his name
decisions.reason: The Hebrew phrase is hard to explain here. It may mean "beside Gedaliah", that is, along with him, or "by means of Gedaliah", because Ishmael lured the men in by using the governor's name (verse 6). The Greek translation is reported to read instead "it was a great cistern", which would come from a Hebrew text with very similar letters. The Hebrew text is kept, in the first sense.

decisions.choice: the cistern King Asa made because of Baasha
decisions.reason: Asa king of Judah and Baasha king of Israel were at war, and Asa fortified Geba and Mizpah against him (1 Kings 15:16-22; 2 Chronicles 16:1-6). Those passages do not mention a cistern, but a great cistern would have kept the town supplied with water in a siege. This one was about three hundred years old.

decisions.choice: filled it with slain: the number of the dead
decisions.reason: The cistern was large, and Ishmael filled it with the bodies of those he had killed.

decisions.choice: for defense against (Balanced); long before, when he was afraid of an attack by (Readable)
decisions.reason: "From the face of Baasha" means because of the threat Baasha posed. Balanced and Readable say so.

decisions.choice: along with Gedaliah
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable follow the first sense in m1. Literal keeps the Hebrew phrase as it stands.

decisions.choice: junto con Gedalías
decisions.reason: "By the hand of Gedaliah" here means along with Gedaliah, or in Gedaliah's charge; the Spanish follows the English at every level.

decisions.choice: "그다랴의 손에" (L); "그다랴와 함께" (B, R)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Hebrew phrase, which the meaning decision reads as "along with Gedaliah".

source.text: וַיִּ֣שְׁבְּ׀יִ֠שְׁמָעֵאל אֶת־כָּל־שְׁאֵרִ֨ית הָעָ֜ם אֲשֶׁ֣ר בַּמִּצְפָּ֗ה אֶת־בְּנ֤וֹת הַמֶּ֨לֶךְ֙ וְאֶת־כָּל־הָעָם֙ הַנִּשְׁאָרִ֣ים בַּמִּצְפָּ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֣ר הִפְקִ֗יד נְבֽוּזַרְאֲדָן֙ רַב־טַבָּחִ֔ים אֶת־גְּדַלְיָ֖הוּ בֶּן־אֲחִיקָ֑ם וַיִּשְׁבֵּם֙ יִשְׁמָעֵ֣אל בֶּן־נְתַנְיָ֔ה וַיֵּ֕לֶךְ לַעֲבֹ֖ר אֶל־בְּנֵ֥י עַמּֽוֹן׃ס

records.literal_gloss: And took captive Ishmael all [the] rest of the people who [were] in Mizpah, the daughters of the king and all the people remaining in Mizpah, whom had appointed Nebuzaradan chief of [the] guards [to] Gedaliah son of Ahikam; and took them captive Ishmael son of Nethaniah, and he went to cross over to [the] sons of Ammon.

en.L: And Ishmael took captive all the rest of the people who [were] at Mizpah, the daughters of the king and all the people who remained at Mizpah, whom Nebuzaradan the chief of the guard had committed to Gedaliah son of Ahikam; and Ishmael son of Nethaniah took them captive and went to cross over to the {{gender:children|sons}} of Ammon.
en.B: Ishmael took captive all the rest of the people who were at Mizpah: the king's daughters and all the others left at Mizpah, whom Nebuzaradan the captain of the guard had placed in the care of Gedaliah son of Ahikam. Ishmael son of Nethaniah carried them off as captives and set out to cross over to the Ammonites.
en.R: Then Ishmael captured all the other people at Mizpah. Among them were the king's daughters and everyone else who had been left at Mizpah. Nebuzaradan, the commander of the royal guard, had put them in Gedaliah's care. Ishmael son of Nethaniah took them as prisoners and set out to cross over to the land of the Ammonites.

es.L: E Ismael llevó cautivo a todo el resto del pueblo que [estaba] en Mizpa, a las hijas del rey y a todo el pueblo que quedaba en Mizpa, al que Nabuzaradán, jefe de la guardia, había encomendado a Gedalías hijo de Ahicam; los llevó cautivos Ismael hijo de Netanías y se fue para pasar a los hijos de Amón.
es.B: Ismael tomó cautivo a todo el resto del pueblo que estaba en Mizpa: las hijas del rey y todos los demás que quedaban en Mizpa, a quienes Nabuzaradán, capitán de la guardia, había puesto al cuidado de Gedalías hijo de Ahicam. Ismael hijo de Netanías se los llevó cautivos y se puso en camino para pasar a los amonitas.
es.R: Luego Ismael capturó a toda la demás gente de Mizpa. Entre ellos estaban las hijas del rey y todos los demás que habían quedado en Mizpa. Nabuzaradán, el comandante de la guardia real, los había dejado al cuidado de Gedalías. Ismael hijo de Netanías se los llevó como prisioneros y se puso en camino para cruzar al país de los amonitas.

fr.L: Et Ismaël emmena captif tout le reste du peuple qui [était] à Mitspa, les filles du roi et tout le peuple qui restait à Mitspa, que Nebouzaradân, chef des gardes, avait confié à Guedalia fils d’Ahiqam ; et Ismaël fils de Netania les emmena captifs et s’en alla pour passer chez les {{gender:enfants|fils}} d’Ammon.
fr.B: Ismaël fit prisonniers tout le reste du peuple qui était à Mitspa : les filles du roi et tous les autres qui étaient restés à Mitspa, et que Nebouzaradân, le commandant de la garde, avait confiés à Guedalia fils d’Ahiqam. Ismaël fils de Netania les emmena captifs et partit pour passer chez les Ammonites.
fr.R: Ensuite Ismaël a capturé tous les autres gens qui étaient à Mitspa. Parmi eux, il y avait les filles du roi et tous ceux qu’on avait laissés à Mitspa. Nebouzaradân, le chef de la garde royale, les avait confiés à Guedalia. Ismaël fils de Netania les a emmenés prisonniers et il est parti pour passer dans le pays des Ammonites.

sw.L: Kisha Ishmaeli akawachukua mateka mabaki yote ya watu waliokuwa Mizpa, binti za mfalme na watu wote waliobaki Mizpa, ambao Nebuzaradani mkuu wa walinzi alikuwa amemkabidhi Gedalia mwana wa Ahikamu; Ishmaeli mwana wa Nethania akawachukua mateka, akaenda kuvuka kwenda kwa wana wa Amoni.
sw.B: Ishmaeli aliwachukua mateka watu wengine wote waliokuwa Mizpa: binti za mfalme na wengine wote waliobaki Mizpa, ambao Nebuzaradani kamanda wa walinzi alikuwa amewaweka chini ya uangalizi wa Gedalia mwana wa Ahikamu. Ishmaeli mwana wa Nethania akawachukua mateka, akaondoka ili avuke kwenda kwa Waamoni.
sw.R: Kisha Ishmaeli aliwakamata watu wengine wote waliokuwa Mizpa. Kati yao walikuwa binti za mfalme na kila mtu mwingine aliyeachwa Mizpa. Nebuzaradani, kamanda wa walinzi wa mfalme, alikuwa amewaweka chini ya uangalizi wa Gedalia. Ishmaeli mwana wa Nethania aliwachukua kama wafungwa, akaondoka ili avuke kwenda nchi ya Waamoni.

vi.L: Ích-ma-ên bắt làm tù binh tất cả phần dân còn lại ở Mích-ba, các con gái của vua và tất cả dân còn lại ở Mích-ba, là những người Nê-bu-xa-a-đan, quan chỉ huy vệ binh, đã giao cho Ghê-đa-lia con trai A-hi-cam; Ích-ma-ên con trai Nê-tha-nia bắt họ làm tù binh và ra đi để qua với con cái Am-môn.
vi.B: Ích-ma-ên bắt làm tù binh tất cả những người còn lại ở Mích-ba: các công chúa và mọi người khác còn lại ở Mích-ba, là những người Nê-bu-xa-a-đan, quan chỉ huy đội cận vệ, đã giao cho Ghê-đa-lia con trai A-hi-cam coi sóc. Ích-ma-ên con trai Nê-tha-nia bắt họ đem đi và lên đường để qua với dân Am-môn.
vi.R: Rồi Ích-ma-ên bắt tất cả những người khác ở Mích-ba. Trong số đó có các công chúa và mọi người khác còn lại ở Mích-ba. Nê-bu-xa-a-đan, người chỉ huy đội cận vệ hoàng gia, đã giao họ cho Ghê-đa-lia coi sóc. Ích-ma-ên con trai Nê-tha-nia bắt họ làm tù binh và lên đường sang xứ của dân Am-môn.

ko.L: 그리고 이스마엘이 미스바에 있던 나머지 모든 백성, 곧 왕의 딸들과 미스바에 남아 있던 모든 백성을 사로잡았는데, 그들은 경호대장 느부사라단이 아히감의 아들 그다랴에게 맡긴 사람들이었다. 느다냐의 아들 이스마엘이 그들을 사로잡아 암몬 {{gender:자손|아들들}}에게로 건너가려고 떠났다.
ko.B: 이스마엘은 미스바에 있던 나머지 백성을 모두 사로잡았다. 그들은 왕의 딸들과 미스바에 남아 있던 모든 사람으로, 경호대장 느부사라단이 아히감의 아들 그다랴에게 맡긴 사람들이었다. 느다냐의 아들 이스마엘은 그들을 포로로 끌고 암몬 사람들에게로 건너가려고 길을 떠났다.
ko.R: 그러고 나서 이스마엘은 미스바에 있던 다른 모든 사람을 사로잡았다. 그 가운데에는 왕의 딸들과 미스바에 남아 있던 모든 사람이 있었다. 왕의 경호대장 느부사라단이 그들을 그다랴에게 맡겨 두었던 것이다. 느다냐의 아들 이스마엘은 그들을 포로로 끌고 암몬 사람들의 땅으로 건너가려고 길을 떠났다.

pt.L: E Ismael levou cativo todo o restante do povo que [estava] em Mispá, as filhas do rei e todo o povo que tinha ficado em Mispá, que Nebuzaradã, o chefe da guarda, tinha confiado a Gedalias, filho de Aicam; e Ismael, filho de Netanias, os levou cativos e foi para passar aos filhos de Amom.
pt.B: Ismael levou cativo todo o restante do povo que estava em Mispá: as filhas do rei e todos os outros que tinham ficado em Mispá, que Nebuzaradã, capitão da guarda, tinha deixado aos cuidados de Gedalias, filho de Aicam. Ismael, filho de Netanias, levou-os como prisioneiros e partiu para atravessar até os amonitas.
pt.R: Depois Ismael capturou todas as outras pessoas que estavam em Mispá. Entre elas estavam as filhas do rei e todos os outros que tinham ficado em Mispá. Nebuzaradã, o comandante da guarda real, tinha deixado essas pessoas aos cuidados de Gedalias. Ismael, filho de Netanias, levou-as como prisioneiras e partiu para atravessar até a terra dos amonitas.

decisions.choice: the daughters of the king: women of the royal house
decisions.reason: These were probably daughters of King Zedekiah, or women of the royal family more widely. They are named again among those taken to Egypt (43:6).

decisions.choice: whom Nebuzaradan had appointed to Gedaliah: placed in his charge
decisions.reason: The verb used for appointing an official here means handing people over to someone's care. Nebuzaradan had left the poorest people of the land and these others under Gedaliah's rule (39:10; 40:7).

decisions.choice: to cross over to the Ammonites: east of the Jordan
decisions.reason: Ammon lay across the Jordan to the east. Baalis king of the Ammonites had sent Ishmael to kill Gedaliah (40:14), so Ishmael was heading back to his protector.

decisions.choice: the chief of the guard (Literal); the captain of the guard (Balanced); the commander of the royal guard (Readable); the Ammonites (Balanced and Readable)
decisions.reason: Nebuzaradan's title is worded as in 2 Kings 25:8. "The sons of Ammon" is the people of Ammon; Literal uses the gender setting, as elsewhere in Jeremiah. Readable adds "the land of" because the Ammonites were a people living in a land of their own.

decisions.choice: os filhos de Amom (L), with no gender setting; os amonitas (B, R)
alternatives: {{gender:os filhos e as filhas|os filhos}} de Amom
decisions.reason: For the whole book: the English Literal puts "the sons of Ammon" under the gender setting. Portuguese "filhos" already includes daughters (the Old Testament terms, as for "os filhos de Israel"), so Literal says "os filhos de Amom" with no setting; Balanced and Readable say "os amonitas", as the English does. Nebuzaradan's title keeps the three wordings of 2 Kings 25:8.

source.text: וַיִּשְׁמַע֙ יוֹחָנָ֣ן בֶּן־קָרֵ֔חַ וְכָל־שָׂרֵ֥י הַחֲיָלִ֖ים אֲשֶׁ֣ר אִתּ֑וֹ אֵ֤ת כָּל־הָֽרָעָה֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשָׂ֔ה יִשְׁמָעֵ֖אל בֶּן־נְתַנְיָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: And heard Johanan son of Kareah and all [the] commanders of the forces who [were] with him all the evil which had done Ishmael son of Nethaniah,

en.L: And Johanan son of Kareah and all the commanders of the forces who [were] with him heard [of] all the evil that Ishmael son of Nethaniah had done,
en.B: When Johanan son of Kareah and all the commanders of the forces with him heard of all the evil Ishmael son of Nethaniah had done,
en.R: Johanan son of Kareah and all the army commanders with him heard about all the evil things Ishmael son of Nethaniah had done.

es.L: Y oyeron Johanán hijo de Carea y todos los jefes de las tropas que [estaban] con él todo el mal que había hecho Ismael hijo de Netanías,
es.B: Cuando Johanán hijo de Carea y todos los jefes de las tropas que estaban con él se enteraron de todo el mal que había hecho Ismael hijo de Netanías,
es.R: Johanán hijo de Carea y todos los jefes del ejército que estaban con él se enteraron de todo el mal que había hecho Ismael hijo de Netanías.

fr.L: Et Yohanân fils de Qaréah et tous les chefs des troupes qui [étaient] avec lui apprirent tout le mal qu’avait fait Ismaël fils de Netania,
fr.B: Quand Yohanân fils de Qaréah et tous les chefs des troupes qui étaient avec lui apprirent tout le mal qu’avait fait Ismaël fils de Netania,
fr.R: Yohanân fils de Qaréah et tous les chefs de l’armée qui étaient avec lui ont appris tout le mal qu’Ismaël fils de Netania avait fait.

sw.L: Lakini Yohana mwana wa Karea na wakuu wote wa majeshi waliokuwa pamoja naye wakasikia [habari ya] mabaya yote aliyoyatenda Ishmaeli mwana wa Nethania,
sw.B: Yohana mwana wa Karea na wakuu wote wa majeshi waliokuwa pamoja naye waliposikia habari ya maovu yote aliyoyatenda Ishmaeli mwana wa Nethania,
sw.R: Yohana mwana wa Karea na makamanda wote wa jeshi waliokuwa pamoja naye walisikia habari za mambo yote mabaya aliyoyafanya Ishmaeli mwana wa Nethania.

vi.L: Giô-ha-nan con trai Ca-rê-át và tất cả các tướng chỉ huy quân lính ở với ông nghe [về] mọi điều ác Ích-ma-ên con trai Nê-tha-nia đã làm,
vi.B: Khi Giô-ha-nan con trai Ca-rê-át và tất cả các tướng chỉ huy quân lính ở với ông nghe về mọi điều ác Ích-ma-ên con trai Nê-tha-nia đã làm,
vi.R: Giô-ha-nan con trai Ca-rê-át và tất cả các tướng chỉ huy quân đội ở với ông nghe về mọi điều ác Ích-ma-ên con trai Nê-tha-nia đã làm.

ko.L: 그리고 가레아의 아들 요하난과 그와 함께 있던 모든 군대 지휘관이 느다냐의 아들 이스마엘이 행한 모든 악을 듣고,
ko.B: 가레아의 아들 요하난과 그와 함께 있던 모든 군대 지휘관은 느다냐의 아들 이스마엘이 저지른 모든 악한 일을 듣고,
ko.R: 가레아의 아들 요하난과 그와 함께 있던 모든 군대 지휘관이 느다냐의 아들 이스마엘이 저지른 모든 악한 일에 관하여 들었다.

pt.L: E Joanã, filho de Careá, e todos os chefes das tropas que [estavam] com ele ouviram [sobre] todo o mal que Ismael, filho de Netanias, tinha feito,
pt.B: Quando Joanã, filho de Careá, e todos os comandantes das tropas que estavam com ele souberam de todo o mal que Ismael, filho de Netanias, tinha feito,
pt.R: Joanã, filho de Careá, e todos os comandantes do exército que estavam com ele souberam de todas as coisas más que Ismael, filho de Netanias, tinha feito.

decisions.choice: the evil: his crimes
decisions.reason: "Evil" here is the wrong Ishmael had done: the murders and the taking of captives.

decisions.choice: Johanan had warned Gedaliah
decisions.reason: Johanan and the other commanders had told Gedaliah that Ishmael was sent to kill him, and Johanan had offered to kill Ishmael first (40:13-16).

decisions.choice: a sentence of its own (Readable); army commanders (Readable)
decisions.reason: Literal and Balanced end with a comma, as the sentence goes on into verse 12. Readable makes the verse a sentence and says "army commanders", as in 2 Kings 25:23.

decisions.choice: os chefes das tropas (L), os comandantes das tropas (B), os comandantes do exército (R)
decisions.reason: For the whole book: the commanders keep the wording 2 Kings 25:23 gives them in Portuguese at each level.

source.text: וַיִּקְחוּ֙ אֶת־כָּל־הָ֣אֲנָשִׁ֔ים וַיֵּ֣לְכ֔וּ לְהִלָּחֵ֖ם עִם־יִשְׁמָעֵ֣אל בֶּן־נְתַנְיָ֑ה וַיִּמְצְא֣וּ אֹת֔וֹ אֶל־מַ֥יִם רַבִּ֖ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר בְּגִבְעֽוֹן׃

records.literal_gloss: and they took all the men and went to fight with Ishmael son of Nethaniah, and they found him at [the] waters [the] great which [are] in Gibeon.

en.L: and they took all the men and went to fight with Ishmael son of Nethaniah, and they found him by the great waters that [are] in Gibeon.
en.B: they took all their men and went to fight against Ishmael son of Nethaniah. They found him by the great pool in Gibeon.
en.R: So they took all their men and set out to fight Ishmael son of Nethaniah. They caught up with him near the large pool at Gibeon.

es.L: y tomaron a todos los hombres y fueron a pelear contra Ismael hijo de Netanías, y lo hallaron junto a las grandes aguas que [están] en Gabaón.
es.B: tomaron a todos sus hombres y fueron a pelear contra Ismael hijo de Netanías. Lo encontraron junto al gran estanque de Gabaón.
es.R: Así que tomaron a todos sus hombres y salieron a pelear contra Ismael hijo de Netanías. Lo alcanzaron cerca del gran estanque de Gabaón.

fr.L: et ils prirent tous les hommes et allèrent combattre contre Ismaël fils de Netania, et ils le trouvèrent près des grandes eaux qui [sont] à Gabaon.
fr.B: ils prirent tous leurs hommes et allèrent combattre Ismaël fils de Netania. Ils le trouvèrent près du grand bassin de Gabaon.
fr.R: Alors ils ont pris tous leurs hommes et sont partis combattre Ismaël fils de Netania. Ils l’ont rattrapé près du grand bassin de Gabaon.

sw.L: wakawachukua watu wote, wakaenda kupigana na Ishmaeli mwana wa Nethania, wakamkuta karibu na maji makubwa yaliyoko Gibeoni.
sw.B: waliwachukua watu wao wote, wakaenda kupigana na Ishmaeli mwana wa Nethania. Wakamkuta karibu na bwawa kubwa lililoko Gibeoni.
sw.R: Basi wakawachukua watu wao wote, wakaenda kupigana na Ishmaeli mwana wa Nethania. Wakamfikia karibu na bwawa kubwa la Gibeoni.

vi.L: thì họ đem tất cả người của mình đi đánh Ích-ma-ên con trai Nê-tha-nia, và gặp hắn bên vùng nước lớn ở Ga-ba-ôn.
vi.B: thì họ đem tất cả người của mình đi đánh Ích-ma-ên con trai Nê-tha-nia. Họ gặp hắn bên hồ lớn ở Ga-ba-ôn.
vi.R: Vậy họ đem tất cả người của mình lên đường đánh Ích-ma-ên con trai Nê-tha-nia. Họ đuổi kịp hắn gần cái hồ lớn ở Ga-ba-ôn.

ko.L: 모든 사람을 데리고 느다냐의 아들 이스마엘과 싸우러 가서, 기브온에 있는 큰 물가에서 그를 만났다.
ko.B: 부하들을 모두 데리고 느다냐의 아들 이스마엘과 싸우러 갔다. 그들은 기브온에 있는 큰 못 가에서 그를 찾아냈다.
ko.R: 그래서 그들은 부하들을 모두 데리고 느다냐의 아들 이스마엘과 싸우러 나섰다. 그들은 기브온에 있는 큰 못 근처에서 그를 따라잡았다.

pt.L: e tomaram todos os homens e foram lutar contra Ismael, filho de Netanias, e o acharam junto às grandes águas que [estão] em Gibeom.
pt.B: reuniram todos os seus homens e foram lutar contra Ismael, filho de Netanias. Eles o encontraram junto ao grande tanque de Gibeom.
pt.R: Então eles reuniram todos os seus homens e foram lutar contra Ismael, filho de Netanias. Eles o alcançaram perto do grande tanque de Gibeom.

decisions.choice: the great waters: a large pool
decisions.reason: This was the pool or reservoir of Gibeon, where the men of David and of Ishbosheth once met (2 Samuel 2:13).

decisions.choice: Gibeon: a town near Mizpah
decisions.reason: Gibeon lay a few miles from Mizpah in the land of Benjamin. Ishmael and his captives had not got far.

decisions.choice: their men; pool (Balanced and Readable); caught up with (Readable)
decisions.reason: "All the men" are the commanders' own men. Balanced and Readable name the great waters as a pool (m1), and Readable says that finding Ishmael meant catching up with him.

decisions.choice: o grande tanque de Gibeom
decisions.reason: The pool (m1) is the one 2 Samuel 2:13 calls "o tanque de Gibeom" in Portuguese; Literal keeps "as grandes águas".

source.text: וַיְהִ֗י כִּרְא֤וֹת כָּל־הָעָם֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר אֶת־יִשְׁמָעֵ֔אל אֶת־יֽוֹחָנָן֙ בֶּן־קָרֵ֔חַ וְאֵ֛ת כָּל־שָׂרֵ֥י הַחֲיָלִ֖ים אֲשֶׁ֣ר אִתּ֑וֹ וַיִּשְׂמָֽחוּ׃

records.literal_gloss: And it was as saw all the people who [were] with Ishmael Johanan son of Kareah and all [the] commanders of the forces who [were] with him, and they rejoiced.

en.L: And it came about, when all the people who [were] with Ishmael saw Johanan son of Kareah and all the commanders of the forces who [were] with him, [that] they rejoiced.
en.B: When all the people Ishmael had with him saw Johanan son of Kareah and all the commanders of the forces with him, they were glad.
en.R: When all the captives with Ishmael saw Johanan son of Kareah and the army commanders with him, they were overjoyed.

es.L: Y sucedió que, cuando todo el pueblo que [estaba] con Ismael vio a Johanán hijo de Carea y a todos los jefes de las tropas que [estaban] con él, se alegraron.
es.B: Cuando toda la gente que Ismael llevaba consigo vio a Johanán hijo de Carea y a todos los jefes de las tropas que estaban con él, se alegraron.
es.R: Cuando todos los cautivos que iban con Ismael vieron a Johanán hijo de Carea y a los jefes del ejército que lo acompañaban, se llenaron de alegría.

fr.L: Et il arriva, quand tout le peuple qui [était] avec Ismaël vit Yohanân fils de Qaréah et tous les chefs des troupes qui [étaient] avec lui, [qu’]ils se réjouirent.
fr.B: Quand tous les gens qu’Ismaël emmenait virent Yohanân fils de Qaréah et tous les chefs des troupes qui l’accompagnaient, ils se réjouirent.
fr.R: Quand tous les prisonniers d’Ismaël ont vu Yohanân fils de Qaréah et les chefs de l’armée qui étaient avec lui, ils ont été remplis de joie.

sw.L: Ikawa watu wote waliokuwa pamoja na Ishmaeli walipomwona Yohana mwana wa Karea na wakuu wote wa majeshi waliokuwa pamoja naye, wakafurahi.
sw.B: Watu wote waliokuwa pamoja na Ishmaeli walipomwona Yohana mwana wa Karea na wakuu wote wa majeshi waliokuwa pamoja naye, walifurahi.
sw.R: Mateka wote waliokuwa pamoja na Ishmaeli walipomwona Yohana mwana wa Karea na makamanda wa jeshi waliokuwa pamoja naye, walifurahi sana.

vi.L: Xảy ra, khi tất cả dân ở với Ích-ma-ên thấy Giô-ha-nan con trai Ca-rê-át và tất cả các tướng chỉ huy quân lính ở với ông, thì họ vui mừng.
vi.B: Khi tất cả những người bị Ích-ma-ên bắt đi thấy Giô-ha-nan con trai Ca-rê-át và tất cả các tướng chỉ huy quân lính ở với ông, họ vui mừng.
vi.R: Khi tất cả những người bị Ích-ma-ên bắt đi thấy Giô-ha-nan con trai Ca-rê-át và các tướng chỉ huy ở với ông, họ mừng rỡ vô cùng.

ko.L: 그리고 이스마엘과 함께 있던 모든 백성이 가레아의 아들 요하난과 그와 함께 있던 모든 군대 지휘관을 보았을 때, 그들이 기뻐했다.
ko.B: 이스마엘에게 끌려가던 모든 백성은 가레아의 아들 요하난과 그와 함께 있던 모든 군대 지휘관을 보고 기뻐했다.
ko.R: 이스마엘에게 사로잡혀 있던 사람들은 가레아의 아들 요하난과 그와 함께 온 군대 지휘관들을 보고 몹시 기뻐했다.

pt.L: E aconteceu que, quando todo o povo que [estava] com Ismael viu Joanã, filho de Careá, e todos os chefes das tropas que [estavam] com ele, eles se alegraram.
pt.B: Quando todo o povo que Ismael levava consigo viu Joanã, filho de Careá, e todos os comandantes das tropas que estavam com ele, ficou alegre.
pt.R: Quando todos os prisioneiros que estavam com Ismael viram Joanã, filho de Careá, e os comandantes do exército que estavam com ele, ficaram muito felizes.

decisions.choice: the people who were with Ishmael: his captives
decisions.reason: These are the people he had taken from Mizpah (verses 10 and 14).

decisions.choice: captives; overjoyed (Readable)
decisions.reason: Readable says who the people were (m1) and uses a stronger word for their relief.

source.text: וַיָּסֹ֨בּוּ֙ כָּל־הָעָ֔ם אֲשֶׁר־שָׁבָ֥ה יִשְׁמָעֵ֖אל מִן־הַמִּצְפָּ֑ה וַיָּשֻׁ֨בוּ֙ וַיֵּ֣לְכ֔וּ אֶל־יֽוֹחָנָ֖ן בֶּן־קָרֵֽחַ׃

records.literal_gloss: And turned around all the people whom had taken captive Ishmael from Mizpah, and they returned and went to Johanan son of Kareah.

en.L: And all the people whom Ishmael had taken captive from Mizpah turned around and returned and went to Johanan son of Kareah.
en.B: All the people Ishmael had taken captive from Mizpah turned around and went back over to Johanan son of Kareah.
en.R: All the people Ishmael had taken from Mizpah turned around and went back to Johanan son of Kareah.

es.L: Y todo el pueblo que Ismael había llevado cautivo de Mizpa se dio la vuelta, y volvieron y se fueron a Johanán hijo de Carea.
es.B: Toda la gente que Ismael se había llevado cautiva de Mizpa se dio la vuelta y se pasó a Johanán hijo de Carea.
es.R: Toda la gente que Ismael se había llevado de Mizpa se dio la vuelta y regresó con Johanán hijo de Carea.

fr.L: Et tout le peuple qu’Ismaël avait emmené captif de Mitspa fit demi-tour, et revint, et alla vers Yohanân fils de Qaréah.
fr.B: Tous les gens qu’Ismaël avait emmenés captifs de Mitspa firent demi-tour et revinrent du côté de Yohanân fils de Qaréah.
fr.R: Tous les gens qu’Ismaël avait emmenés de Mitspa ont fait demi-tour et sont retournés vers Yohanân fils de Qaréah.

sw.L: Basi watu wote ambao Ishmaeli aliwachukua mateka kutoka Mizpa wakageuka, wakarudi, wakaenda kwa Yohana mwana wa Karea.
sw.B: Watu wote ambao Ishmaeli aliwachukua mateka kutoka Mizpa waligeuka, wakarudi kujiunga na Yohana mwana wa Karea.
sw.R: Watu wote ambao Ishmaeli aliwachukua kutoka Mizpa waligeuka, wakarudi kwa Yohana mwana wa Karea.

vi.L: Tất cả dân mà Ích-ma-ên đã bắt từ Mích-ba quay lại, trở về và đi theo Giô-ha-nan con trai Ca-rê-át.
vi.B: Tất cả những người Ích-ma-ên đã bắt từ Mích-ba quay lại và chạy sang với Giô-ha-nan con trai Ca-rê-át.
vi.R: Tất cả những người Ích-ma-ên đã bắt từ Mích-ba quay lại và trở về với Giô-ha-nan con trai Ca-rê-át.

ko.L: 그리고 이스마엘이 미스바에서 사로잡아 온 모든 백성이 돌아서서 가레아의 아들 요하난에게로 돌아갔다.
ko.B: 이스마엘이 미스바에서 사로잡아 온 백성은 모두 발길을 돌려 가레아의 아들 요하난에게 넘어갔다.
ko.R: 이스마엘이 미스바에서 끌고 온 사람들은 모두 발길을 돌려 가레아의 아들 요하난에게 돌아갔다.

pt.L: E todo o povo que Ismael tinha levado cativo de Mispá deu a volta, e voltaram e foram a Joanã, filho de Careá.
pt.B: Todo o povo que Ismael tinha levado cativo de Mispá deu meia-volta e passou para o lado de Joanã, filho de Careá.
pt.R: Todas as pessoas que Ismael tinha levado de Mispá deram meia-volta e voltaram para Joanã, filho de Careá.

decisions.choice: turned around, returned and went: they left Ishmael at once
decisions.reason: Three verbs in a row show the captives breaking away and going over to Johanan on the spot.

decisions.choice: went back over to (Balanced); went back to (Readable)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable join "returned and went" into one phrase.

source.text: וְיִשְׁמָעֵ֣אל בֶּן־נְתַנְיָ֗ה נִמְלַט֙ בִּשְׁמֹנָ֣ה אֲנָשִׁ֔ים מִפְּנֵ֖י יֽוֹחָנָ֑ן וַיֵּ֖לֶךְ אֶל־בְּנֵ֥י עַמּֽוֹן׃ס

records.literal_gloss: And Ishmael son of Nethaniah escaped with eight men from [the] face of Johanan, and he went to [the] sons of Ammon.

en.L: But Ishmael son of Nethaniah escaped with eight men from before Johanan, and he went to the {{gender:children|sons}} of Ammon.
en.B: But Ishmael son of Nethaniah got away from Johanan with eight men and went to the Ammonites.
en.R: But Ishmael son of Nethaniah escaped from Johanan with eight of his men, and he went to the land of the Ammonites.

es.L: Pero Ismael hijo de Netanías escapó con ocho hombres de delante de Johanán, y se fue a los hijos de Amón.
es.B: Pero Ismael hijo de Netanías se le escapó a Johanán con ocho hombres y se fue a los amonitas.
es.R: Pero Ismael hijo de Netanías se le escapó a Johanán con ocho de sus hombres y se fue al país de los amonitas.

fr.L: Mais Ismaël fils de Netania s’échappa avec huit hommes de devant Yohanân, et il alla chez les {{gender:enfants|fils}} d’Ammon.
fr.B: Mais Ismaël fils de Netania échappa à Yohanân avec huit hommes et s’en alla chez les Ammonites.
fr.R: Mais Ismaël fils de Netania a échappé à Yohanân avec huit de ses hommes, et il est allé dans le pays des Ammonites.

sw.L: Lakini Ishmaeli mwana wa Nethania akaokoka pamoja na watu wanane kutoka mbele ya Yohana, akaenda kwa wana wa Amoni.
sw.B: Lakini Ishmaeli mwana wa Nethania alimtoroka Yohana pamoja na watu wanane, akaenda kwa Waamoni.
sw.R: Lakini Ishmaeli mwana wa Nethania alimtoroka Yohana pamoja na watu wake wanane, akaenda nchi ya Waamoni.

vi.L: Nhưng Ích-ma-ên con trai Nê-tha-nia cùng tám người trốn thoát khỏi Giô-ha-nan, và đi đến với con cái Am-môn.
vi.B: Nhưng Ích-ma-ên con trai Nê-tha-nia cùng tám người trốn thoát khỏi Giô-ha-nan và chạy sang với dân Am-môn.
vi.R: Nhưng Ích-ma-ên con trai Nê-tha-nia cùng tám người của hắn trốn thoát khỏi Giô-ha-nan và chạy sang xứ của dân Am-môn.

ko.L: 그러나 느다냐의 아들 이스마엘은 여덟 사람과 함께 요하난 앞에서 도망하여 암몬 {{gender:자손|아들들}}에게로 갔다.
ko.B: 그러나 느다냐의 아들 이스마엘은 여덟 사람과 함께 요하난에게서 빠져나가 암몬 사람들에게로 갔다.
ko.R: 그러나 느다냐의 아들 이스마엘은 부하 여덟 명과 함께 요하난에게서 도망쳐 암몬 사람들의 땅으로 갔다.

pt.L: Mas Ismael, filho de Netanias, escapou com oito homens de diante de Joanã, e foi aos filhos de Amom.
pt.B: Mas Ismael, filho de Netanias, fugiu de Joanã com oito homens e foi para os amonitas.
pt.R: Mas Ismael, filho de Netanias, escapou de Joanã com oito dos seus homens e foi para a terra dos amonitas.

decisions.choice: with eight men: two fewer than the ten who came with him
decisions.reason: Ishmael had come with ten men (verse 1). The text does not say what became of the other two.

decisions.choice: from before Johanan: out of his reach
decisions.reason: "From the face of" Johanan means away from him, so that Johanan could not catch him.

decisions.choice: of his men; the land of (Readable)
decisions.reason: As in verse 10. Readable says the eight were his own men.

source.text: וַיִּקַּח֩ יוֹחָנָ֨ן בֶּן־קָרֵ֜חַ וְכָל־שָׂרֵ֧י הַחֲיָלִ֣ים אֲשֶׁר־אִתּ֗וֹ אֵ֣ת כָּל־שְׁאֵרִ֤ית הָעָם֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר הֵ֠שִׁיב מֵאֵ֨ת יִשְׁמָעֵ֤אל בֶּן־נְתַנְיָה֙ מִן־הַמִּצְפָּ֔ה אַחַ֣ר הִכָּ֔ה אֶת־גְּדַלְיָ֖ה בֶּן־אֲחִיקָ֑ם גְּבָרִ֞ים אַנְשֵׁ֣י הַמִּלְחָמָ֗ה וְנָשִׁ֤ים וְטַף֙ וְסָ֣רִסִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר הֵשִׁ֖יב מִגִּבְעֽוֹן׃

records.literal_gloss: And took Johanan son of Kareah and all [the] commanders of the forces who [were] with him all [the] rest of the people whom he brought back from with Ishmael son of Nethaniah from Mizpah, after he struck Gedaliah son of Ahikam: men, men of the war, and women and little ones and eunuchs, whom he brought back from Gibeon.

en.L: And Johanan son of Kareah and all the commanders of the forces who [were] with him took all the rest of the people whom he had brought back from Ishmael son of Nethaniah, from Mizpah, after he had struck down Gedaliah son of Ahikam: men, men of war, and women and little ones and eunuchs, whom he had brought back from Gibeon.
en.B: Then Johanan son of Kareah and all the commanders of the forces with him took charge of all the rest of the people from Mizpah. Johanan had rescued them from Ishmael son of Nethaniah after the murder of Gedaliah son of Ahikam. They were fighting men, women, children and court officers, whom Johanan had brought back from Gibeon.
en.R: Johanan son of Kareah and all the army commanders with him then took charge of all the people from Mizpah who were left. Johanan had rescued them from Ishmael son of Nethaniah, who had killed Gedaliah son of Ahikam. There were soldiers, women, children and palace officials, and Johanan had brought them back from Gibeon.
